tasks.title: Guard admits read-only task --prompt-file with resolved containment; guard test matrix
tasks.objective: Close the read-only rescue gap: _companion_readonly_launch_ok() in pre_tool_use.py admits --prompt-file on the task verb only — exactly one value, repo-relative existing regular file whose resolved path stays under the resolved repo root — replacing the explicit default-deny. Every containment failure and every currently-refused shape keeps refusing. Guard tests gain the admission case and the containment matrix; regressions stay untouched.
acceptance_criteria: In factory/scripts/pre_tool_use.py, the explicit --prompt-file default-deny (currently ~lines 594-603) is replaced by admission logic inside _companion_readonly_launch_ok(): the flag is accepted ONLY when the verb is 'task', it appears exactly once with exactly one value (both '--prompt-file <path>' and '--prompt-file=<path>' forms handled or the unsupported form refused explicitly), and the value is a repo-relative path to an existing regular file whose fully resolved target (Path.resolve()) is contained under the resolved repo root (Path.is_relative_to). Internal symlinks that resolve inside the repo are admitted; symlinks resolving outside, absolute paths, '..' traversal, dangling paths, and directories are refused. Every refusal falls through to the existing refusal message path — no new silent failure mode, no quieter message.

The flag remains refused on 'status' and 'task-resume-candidate' verbs, and READONLY_COMPANION_FLAGS/write-shape/wrapper/shell-syntax vetting is otherwise byte-identical: the existing refusal structure is narrowed by exactly one validated admission, nothing else.

factory/tests/test_gates.py: test_hook_allows_readonly_companion_task_launch (~:4820) gains the valid prompt-file task shape (create a real brief file in the fixture repo); test_hook_denies_file_and_cwd_overrides_in_readonly_lane (~:12674) converts its prompt-file case into the containment matrix — absolute path, '..' traversal, symlink resolving outside the repo, dangling path, directory, duplicate flag/value, and the flag on a non-task verb — while retaining its --cwd and unknown-flag denials. test_companion_guard_admits_read_only_and_refuses_write_shapes (~:4593) and the quoted-write-laundering (~:4760), wrapped/computed-launch (~:12710), and shell-expansion (~:12726) regressions stay green UNMODIFIED.
Full gate suite green: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "companion or readonly_lane"
tasks.reviewer_focus: This loosens a security guard: verify the admission is task-verb-scoped and value-validated with BOTH sides resolved before containment comparison; verify no other refusal got quieter or reordered; verify the containment matrix actually exercises an external symlink and a dangling path, not just lexical traversal; regressions must be diff-untouched.

plan_contracts.statement: The guard admits --prompt-file in the read-only lane only on the task verb, with exactly one value naming a repo-relative existing regular file whose resolved path is contained under the resolved repo root.

Absolute, traversal, dangling, directory, externally-resolving-symlink, duplicate-value, and wrong-verb prompt-file shapes are refused, and every pre-existing refusal (shell syntax, wrappers, write flags, --cwd, unknown flags) behaves exactly as before.
The guard test matrix covers the admission and each containment refusal at the three named test sites, with the laundering/wrapper/expansion regression tests left unmodified.
A multi-paragraph brief reaches Codex through the read-only file route in a live end-to-end run, and the same invocation with a traversal path is refused live.
